value.text: Books intended primarily for consultation rather than for consecutive reading
主要為用於參閱用，而非做連續性閱讀的書籍。
Boeken die in de eerste plaats bedoeld zijn om iets in op te zoeken in plaats van om te lezen
Libros destinados fundamentalmente para consultas en lugar de emplearse para una lectura continua
Works intended primarily for consultation rather than for consecutive reading.

Books designed by the arrangement and treatment of their subject matter to be consulted for definite terms of information rather than to be read consecutively. Reference books include DICTIONARIES; ENCYCLOPEDIAS; ATLASES; etc. (From the ALA Glossary of Library and Information Science, 1983)
Use as a topical subdivision under subjects for works about reference works on those subjects.
Verk som gjennom ordning og emnebehandling er egnet til oppsporing av kortfattede, konsise opplysninger (Biblioterm).
